value.a: FINGERPRINT vs GIT INTEGRITY: git's content-addressable storage provides integrity for committed files. The fingerprint adds in-place-edit detection BEFORE commit and portable verification from the record alone.

FINGERPRINT vs SOURCE_FINGERPRINT: source_fingerprint covers proof source code (has the proof changed since sealed?). This covers crossing records (was the crossing record tampered with after the crossing?). Different subjects, same mechanism.
FINGERPRINT vs STATE-AND-HISTORY-DOOR: that ticket catches in-place edits via git-diff; this catches them via hash mismatch. Different detection mechanisms, complementary.
